release-item.p: Fix block incremental restore issue on non-default repository.

When the backup being restored used block incremental and was not in the lowest numbered repository, the restore read part of the block incremental data from the lowest numbered repository. Setting repo worked around the problem.
Do not set recovery_target_timeline=current for PostgreSQL < 12.

Before 12, explicitly setting recovery_target_timeline to current behaves as latest, although current is the default. The setting is now left out of recovery.conf when it is set to current for these versions.
Fix expire archive range logging.
Only the last archive path removed was logged as the start of the range, so the log suggested that far fewer files were expired than were.
Fix error reporting for queries with no results.
An error from a query that expected no results was reported as an unexpected result instead of as the error.
Verify recovery target timeline.

A backup that cannot follow the target timeline, e.g. one made after a standby was promoted and the new timeline forked off, failed only when recovery started, with a error that is hard to interpret. The timeline is now checked against the history files before the restore starts.
Allow verification of a specified backup.
The verify option --set verifies only the specified backup and the WAL required to make it consistent.

release-item.p: Add support for S3/GCS requester pays.
Set repo-s3-requester-pays or repo-gcs-user-project to bill the requester instead of the bucket owner, e.g. so a hosted service can give customers access to their backups.

commit.subject: PostgreSQL 18 experimental support.

release-item.p: PostgreSQL 18 support.
This release was made before 18 had a beta, so support was initially experimental. Nothing that affects changed before 18.0.
Allow connections to on abstract domain sockets.
pg-socket-path no longer has to be an absolute path, so it can name an abstract domain socket. libpq reports a path that is not valid.
Add numeric output to version command.
Set --output=num to output the version as a number, e.g. 2055000, which is easier to compare.

commit.subject: Refactor protocol helper.
Allow backup command to operate on remote repositories.

release-item.p: Allow backup command to operate on remote repositories.
The backup command can now run on a host where the repository is remote, which allows more flexibility in where backups are run.

commit.subject: Use lz4 for protocol compression.
Remove reference to disabling network compression in the documentation.

release-item.p: Use lz4 for protocol compression.
lz4 compresses much faster than gz and gives similar ratios at the low levels used for protocol compression. Setting compress-level-network=0 no longer disables protocol compression.
Calculate content-md5 on S3 only when required.
The content-md5 header is only calculated for batch delete requests, which require it, to save CPU when files are uploaded. This change was reverted in v2.55.1.
Warn when a value for a multi-key option is overwritten.
Options with key/value pairs, e.g. recovery-option, silently overwrote a value when its key was specified again. A warning is now logged.

release-item.p: Add detail logging for expired archive path.
Removing a large number of archive files could look like a hang. A message at detail level now shows progress.
Remove support for PostgreSQL 9.4.
9.4 is no longer supported, per the policy of supporting five end-of-life versions of . Backups of 9.4 clusters can still be expired.
Remove autoconf/make build.
v2.54.0 was the last release to support the autoconf/make build. Use meson to build.

release-item.p: Clean up code.
Fix documentation for specifying multiple stanzas with tls-server-auth.
Multiple stanzas are specified for tls-server-auth as a comma-separated list. The documentation said to repeat the option.
Clarify incremental backup expiration.

The documentation implied that incremental backups are expired by count. It now explains how incremental backups are expired and that full backups count as differential backups for differential retention.
Clarify requirement for local/remote versions to match.
Add FAQ about exporting self-contained cluster.
The FAQ explains how to create a self-contained export of a cluster with a backup made with --archive-copy and restored with --type=none.
Caveat --tablespace-map-all regarding tablespace creation.
A tablespace created after the backup starts is not in the manifest, so tablespace-map-all cannot map it.
Clarify behavior of --repo-retention-full-type.
Change --process-max recommendation for object stores to --repo-bundle.
On object stores repo-bundle reduces the time spent creating files far more than process-max does, because fewer files are created.
Update unix_socket_directory to unix_socket_directories.
unix_socket_directory has not been valid since 9.2, so only unix_socket_directories is documented.
Recommend not placing spool-path within pg_xlog/pg_wal.
A spool path inside pg_xlog or pg_wal can cause problems for tools such as pg_rewind.
